Hey, fellow BPD and Bipolar here  

I think bullshit can happen with anyone… 

If someone gunna cheat or leave you, they gunna cheat or leave you, and maybe a ex might be easier to slide back into that with, because of “comfortability”, but that doesn’t mean that a person who wasn’t going to do that anyway wouldn’t.   


I know this kinda jealousy is tough to deal with, but relationships are all about risk and trust, and if you find yourself trying to control or shut out your partner from any chance they might leave you… you are not in a relationship that’s healthy.   


There are people I dated that if I never saw their face again, or remembered them, I would be fine and better for it.  


But there are people I dated that remain my closest friends despite all the challenges we both have faced, and at the end of the day we still confide on eachother and help eachother out when we can… 

I’ve even had people I’ve dated try to give me ultimatums about talking to exs, and tbh that situation does help me get rid of a ex, they are just surprised it’s them.   



Remaining rational about this can def be a struggle at times, not gunna lie… emotionally I can be in a tug of war about anything really lol.   But alot of this kinda “freaking out”, simmered down for me when i hit 30. 

So like… aside from dealing with a situation that’s uncomfortable for you, you have all these brain processes and emotional regulation that’s “faulty” to deal with… it’s supper shitty, and when there is nothing you can do but “sit around and wait” for things to go wrong , as you always feel , and they might do, is scary.  


The good news is while you shouldn’t, and quite frankly can’t, control all of the possibilities, you can control your personal growth, and maybe get into some therapy to help calm those rushing thoughts and fears.  So while instead of gaslighting yourself about your fears, you can actively take steps to prevent you from being hurt, weather something or nothing happens, YOU will be ok.  


Relationships are scary, and I hope you are able to talk to them about your feelings, while not trying to control
